name: emotion5_v2
pipeline: per-session Euclidean alignment (R^-1/2, R = mean 1-45 Hz spatial covariance, 0-4 s) -> 1-30 Hz band-pass -> subtract the 0.5 s pre-stimulus mean -> 0-937.5 ms in 20 bins of 12 samples x 30 channels = 600 -> StandardScaler -> shrinkage LDA (lsqr, auto, equal priors)
trained_on: 370 QC-passed image trials, one participant, 30-channel Emotiv FLEX2, 256 Hz, EmotivPRO band-passed export (no other cleaning)
